items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: My wife's got all that but I don't know where they at. She's got them. Should've been home, I forgot to tell her about that. She's got all the pictures.

ctx.x: a mark on the Browns, Raymond Brown's lip there. Yeah, that's what I'm trombone. That's what I kind of look at. I'll make a note here. We have this picture. Maybe someday we can bring a camera by and take a new shot of it. Just reproduce it. This is in a tuxedo all dressed up, I guess, ready to play. Any other pictures? I guess you don't have anything else but you're around of early bands.
My wife's got all that but I don't know where they at. She's got them. Should've been home, I forgot to tell her about that. She's got all the pictures.
